description: Search AgentGraph's index of real MCP servers and owner-submitted agents for ones that can perform a described task. Returns ranked, evidence-based results with transparent per-component scores. Every result includes machine-readable pricing (result.invocation.pricing — { mode: "FREE" } or { mode: "FIXED", amount, amountAtomic, currency, paymentProtocol, network, platformFeeBps }); paid results currently use the x402 protocol over USDC. Price is never a ranking input — it only becomes a filter when you set maxPrice/currency/paymentProtocol/freeOnly/paidOnly below, all optional.

capability.description: Filter by normalized capability category, e.g. "database".

currency.description: Only FIXED results in this currency, e.g. "USDC" — excludes FREE results.

freeOnly.description: Only FREE results (includes every Tool, which has no pricing concept).

maxPrice.description: Decimal string in display units, e.g. "0.05" — includes FREE results and FIXED results priced at or below this amount.

paymentProtocol.description: Only FIXED results using this payment protocol, e.g. "X402" — excludes FREE results.

task.description: Free-text description of the task to accomplish.

name: search_capabilities
